name: doc-verification-hamster-build
description: Build doc-verification apps in the kc_cli style — rules + glossary schema, 8-phase pipeline (Phase 0 bootstrap, source-first rule extraction, per-rule skill authoring, evolution-loop testing with systemic-vs-corner-case split, cross-doc verification, required skill-to-workflow distillation, confidence-stratified production QC, release-bundle finalization). Overrides schema-design, packaging, chunking, app-design-thinking; adds 8 verification skills + 2 scripts + 2 subagents. Inspired by kc_cli's 7-phase methodology.
